basic.nicknameMax: Nickname must be at most 64 characters
basic.emailHint: Shown in member and account information. Clear and save to remove your email.
basic.emailMax: Email must be at most 128 characters
basic.phoneHint: Supports country codes, spaces and hyphens. Clear and save to remove your phone number.
basic.phoneMax: Phone number must be at most 32 characters
basic.phoneInvalid: Use only digits, spaces and hyphens, with an optional + country code prefix

password.title: Account security
password.min: Password must be at least 6 characters
password.successHint: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

deactivation.title: Delete account
deactivation.notice: Once deleted, your account can no longer sign in and every issued credential is invalidated immediately. Your work items, comments and other history are retained and shown under your username from before deletion.
deactivation.warning: This deletes your account immediately (data is retained)
deactivation.warningHint: A deleted account cannot be restored from the profile page; contact a platform administrator to restore it under User management.
deactivation.rule1: 1. Deletion is blocked while you have unfinished work items, are the sole administrator of a workspace, or own any workspace
deactivation.rule2: 2. Deletion takes effect immediately and cannot be undone from the profile page
deactivation.rule3: 3. A platform administrator can restore the account; workspace access and the IM user ID must be reconfigured by an administrator
deactivation.confirmPrompt: Enter your username <identity/> to confirm deletion:
